description: This file defines a React hook, useKeyList, used to fetch, manage, and provide access to a list of keys within a team or organization context. It manages state for key data, loading, and errors, and interacts with networking functions to retrieve data from an external API. Also defines TypeScript interfaces for key-related data and component props.

methods.name: useKeyList
methods.description: React hook managing retrieval and state of key list data, providing loading status, errors, pagination info, and methods to refresh or set keys.
